summary: Frontend-only verification of Excel-sim row auto-height fix + simplified-sim regen on session 7b6958fc-e468-427a-b4cd-514ebe8d4cfd (Phase 4/4, testagent2026@gmail.com). Row auto-height works: no visual overlap between rows in either Data or Answers sheet, Univer boots cleanly (no boot errors, no crash). Empty-submit flow works end-to-end: spreadsheet-submit-btn -> spreadsheet-score-banner shows 'Score: 0/100 · 0 correct / 2 need work' -> spreadsheet-solution-reveal expandable panel shows Answers!B4=650 (=SUM(Data!B2:B6)) and Answers!B5=130 (=AVERAGE(Data!B2:B6)) -> simulation-continue-btn ('Continue to results →') navigates to /session/.../start with no error. HOWEVER, the simplified-sim regen (Feature #2) is only partially applied for this session: the Data sheet still contains the OLD 10 data rows (FY15..FY24 with big numbers like 28500, 32800, ...), NOT the promised <=5 tiny-number rows; and the Answers sheet still has legacy 'Question 1..Question 5:' label rows in column A instead of the promised plain-English 'Step N: type =FORMULA(...) then press Enter' instructions. Only 2 answer cells (B4, B5) are graded which matches the '2-3 answer cells' claim, but the expected values (650, 130) are IMPOSSIBLE to produce from the actual Data sheet — SUM(Data!B2:B6) of the visible data = 232190, not 650. This means the LLM regen updated expected_answers/scoring but did NOT rewrite the workbook cell payload for this simulation.

integration_issues.issue: Data sheet + Answers sheet content is INCONSISTENT with expected_answers. Data sheet still shows 10 rows (FY15-FY24, values 28500..79500). Answers sheet A1..A5 contain 5 Question labels ('Question 1: Total Revenue FY15-FY24 (₹Cr)' ... 'Question 5: Net Profit Growth FY24 vs FY15 (₹Cr)') instead of 2-3 plain-English 'Step N: type =FORMULA(...) then press Enter' instructions. Expected answers say B4=650 with =SUM(Data!B2:B6) but Data!B2:B6 actually sums to 232190. Regen script left the workbook payload for this session unmodified while replacing expected_answers.

issues: Long 'Question N:' labels in column A overflow horizontally into adjacent empty cells (not wrapping onto multiple lines). Cells with wrap-text enabled would benefit from the row-height fix, but in this rendered sim the labels remain single-line overflow so the auto-height code path is not actually exercised. Consider verifying on a sim whose regen actually landed to see wrapped multi-line rendering.
